## Preparation

```{r}
pacman::p_load(dplyr, tidyverse, ggplot2, quanteda, quanteda.textplots,
               tidytext, readxl, readr, stm) 
```

# Japan

## Load Data

\`\`\`{r}

```{r}
data <- read_excel("../Data/Japan_merged_2024.xlsx")
Japan_full <- data %>% 
  select(headline, abstract, section, Merged, query_date)
```

## Visualization

```{r}
# Turn Value count to a table
value_counts <- table(Japan_full$section)
value_df <- as.data.frame(value_counts)

# Order by descending order
top15_df <- value_df[order(-value_df$Freq), ]

# Select top 10 rows
top15_df <- head(top15_df, 15)
```

```{r}
#Make sure the the counts are ranked for decending order for this plot (asked ChatGTP)
top15_df$Var1 <- factor(top15_df$Var1, levels = top15_df$Var1[order(-top15_df$Freq)])

# Ensure Category is treated as a factor with correct order
ggplot(top15_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 15 Category Counts",
       x = "Category",
       y = "Count") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave("Japan_true_dis.png")
```

## World Cloud

```{r}
#remove all '
Japan_full$Merged <- gsub("[‘’´`]", "'", Japan_full$Merged)  #Turn all
Japan_full$Merged<- gsub("'", "", Japan_full$Merged) 

#Preprocessing
full_tokens <- tokens(Japan_full$Merged, 
                      remove_punct = TRUE,
                      remove_numbers = TRUE)
full_tokens <- tokens_remove(full_tokens, c(stopwords("en"), "Briefing",'u.s','Monday',
                                            'Tuesday','Wednesday', 'Thursday','Friday','Saturday', 'October', 'Japans', 'Chinas', 'Trumps',
                                            'can','year','like'))

full_dfm <- dfm(full_tokens) 
full_dfm <- full_dfm[rowSums(full_dfm) > 0,] # keep only the rows with non-zero
```

```{r}
#png("Japan_cloud.png", width = 2000, height = 1600)
textplot_wordcloud(full_dfm , random_order = FALSE,
                   rotation = .25, max_words = 90,
                   min_size = 0.3, max_size = 7,
                   color = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Set2"))


#dev.off()
```

## STM

## Model Performance: picking best K

```{r}
#|message: false 
#|warning: false
#|results: 'hide'

set.seed(1234)
dfm_stm <- quanteda::convert(full_dfm, to = "stm")

k_result <- searchK(documents = dfm_stm$documents,
                    vocab = dfm_stm$vocab,
                    data = dfm_stm$meta,
                    K = c(5, 8, 10, 15, 20),
                    prevalence = ~1,  # Or include covariates here
                    init.type = "Spectral")
```

## Best K Result

```{r}
#png("Japan_k.png", width = 600, height = 450)
plot(k_result)
```

## Final Model

```{r}
#|message: false 
#|warning: false
#|results: 'hide'
set.seed(1234)
dfm_stm <- quanteda::convert(full_dfm, to = "stm")

# fit stm model with K topics
stm_m <- stm(documents = dfm_stm$documents, 
             vocab = dfm_stm$vocab, 
             data = dfm_stm$meta, 
             K = 20, 
             init.type = "Spectral")
```

## Topic Distribution

```{r}
#This command tells you the topic distribution
#png("Japan_K20.png", width = 600, height = 450)
#labelTopics(stm_m)
par(mar = c(3, 1, 3, 1)) 
plot(stm_m, n = 4)
```
